# Step 1: Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_str = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
restaurant_names = restaurants_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Get cuisine types for all restaurants

# Step 3: Filter for French cuisine restaurants
french_restaurants = [name for name in restaurant_names if cuisine_types.get(name, "").lower() == "french"]

# Step 4: Get opening hours for French restaurants
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_restaurants)

# Step 5: Find which French restaurants are open on Sunday
class RestaurantSundayOpen(BaseModel):
    name: str
    is_open_sunday: bool

sunday_open_info = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Given the following opening hours for the restaurant '{name}': '{opening_hours[name]}', is the restaurant open on Sunday? Return the restaurant name and a boolean indicating if it is open on Sunday.",
        RestaurantSundayOpen
    )
    for name in french_restaurants
]

sunday_open_restaurants = [info.name for info in sunday_open_info if info.is_open_sunday]

# Step 6: Get ratings and reviews for those open on Sunday
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(sunday_open_restaurants)

# Step 7: Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews
class RestaurantRating(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float
    review_summary: str

restaurant_ratings = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the numeric rating and a brief review summary from the following review information for restaurant '{name}': '{ratings_reviews[name]}'. Return the restaurant name, rating (as a float), and a short review summary.",
        RestaurantRating
    )
    for name in sunday_open_restaurants
]

if len(restaurant_ratings) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No French restaurants open on Sunday found in Paris.")

best_restaurant = max(restaurant_ratings, key=lambda x: x.rating)

# Step 8: Get address and operating hours for the best restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant.name]).get(best_restaurant.name)
operating_hours = opening_hours[best_restaurant.name]

# Step 9: Print the result
print(
    "Recommended French restaurant in Paris open on Sunday:\n"
    f"Name: {best_restaurant.name}\n"
    f"Rating: {best_restaurant.rating}\n"
    f"Address: {address}\n"
    f"Operating Hours: {operating_hours}\n"
    f"Review Summary: {best_restaurant.review_summary}"
)
